feeding_claim.verbatim: We are producing pasture raised pork, chicken, turkey, and eggs outdoors on a rotational grazing system

pickup_locations: Isom's Orchard, Athens (eggs, retail and summer to fall market)

notes: Feed is grown and milled on the farm (wheat and alfalfa are grown; soybeans grown and sold); hogs have free-choice feed. Chickens rotated daily on fresh pasture. Eggs are from free-ranging hens on alfalfa fields. Farm pickup Monday, Wednesday, Friday 4 to 5pm and Sunday noon to 1pm; delivery Monday and Tuesday evenings by flat rate per zip. Restaurants include Farm Burger, Huntsville and Continental Bakery, Birmingham. Homepage mentions turkey; products page does not, so turkey is not listed separately. No phone found on the site.
